comparison.objective: Bimanually shake a sieve to separate soil from pebbles, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Level two-handle lifting and cyclic shaking differ from small-tool alignment, screw torque, fine collar rotation, relocking, and measured-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Success depends on passing sufficient crumbs while retaining all pebbles and returning the sieve; the candidate depends on repeatable force/travel-bounded stopping without drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve dynamic motion, but separation by shaking is a different tested ability from tuning a dissipative mechanism.
